subject: Customer kickoff — confirm bridge, roles, and attendee matrix

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>

Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>

Subject: Customer kickoff — initial slots and proposed roles

Hi Sam / Priya —

Thanks again for choosing Redwood for the inference rollout. The implementation team is ready to run the kickoff and we want to lock a time that covers your US-based engineering/product folks. To avoid switching threads, I pulled in Karthik and Priyom from our eng team for role confirmation.

Proposed 90-minute kickoff (please pick one):
- Tue May 25, 10:00–11:30 PDT (UTC-7)
- Wed May 26, 14:00–15:30 PDT (UTC-7)
- Thu May 27, 08:00–09:30 PDT (UTC-7)

Draft agenda (attached: spruce-kickoff-agenda-v1.pdf):
1) Introductions & success criteria (10m)
2) Architecture & network checklist (20m)
3) Roles & ownership (30m)
4) Implementation milestones / mutual action plan (20m)
5) Q&A and next steps (10m)

Attendee matrix (please confirm who from your side will attend and any additional stakeholders):
- Sam Hughes — Product lead (primary)
- Priya Rao — Engineering manager
- IT oncall — Network/security (please provide contact)

Redwood hosts: Karthik (runtime lead), Priyom (onboarding/ops), Marissa (CS lead). We can assign bridge hosts and rotation once you confirm the slot.

Pre-reqs/gating items (if you have them ahead of time):
- VPN/static egress IP address for our test worker (if private deployment)
- SOC 2 evidence request items (if you need them before kickoff)

Action: Reply with preferred slot and final attendee list. I’ll send calendar invite and bridge details once confirmed.

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0128
